text: Screen redos 2026-11-22 (athlete photos/videos; supersedes the provisional 2026-11-16 knee-to-wall, overhead reach and ASLR). Knee-to-wall (tape): big toe ~6 in (15 cm) left, ~5.75 in (14.5 cm) right: symmetric, good ankle dorsiflexion. Back-to-wall overhead reach, heels ~15 cm out, upright: hands reach the wall with elbows near straight: pass (low back arch not clearly visible). ASLR, down leg straight: raised leg ~80 deg (near vertical) both sides, slight knee bend: good hamstring/hip flexion, no asymmetry. PVC overhead squat (side + front): depth about parallel, heels down, knees track over toes with no cave, symmetric; at the bottom the torso leans forward and the PVC drifts in front of the ears (limited shoulder flexion / T-spine extension, fits GOWOD overhead 61). Overhead squat is not competent yet: keep overhead and olympic rungs at 0; keep wall slides, T-spine extension and lat/pec mobility in upper warm-ups; retest at the transition week.
